question: The Supreme Court ruled in the Kesavananda Bharati case of _________ that the Preamble is a constituent of the Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1973.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preamble is an introductory and declarative statement that outlines the document's thing and underpinning gospel.
 
• It was decided by two important Supreme court judgments popularly known as, **the Berubari Union Case( 1960) and the Kesavananda Bharati case( 1973).**
 
• still, Preamble is the part of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The **Preamble defines the Constitution's abecedarian association.**
 
• In a court of law, the preamble is neither enforceable nor defendable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Amendments to the Preamble:**

 
 
• The Preamble was amended only formerly by the **42nd Amendment of 1976.**
 
• The Amendment added the terms** Socialist, temporal, and Integrity** in the Preamble.
 
• **Socialist:** It's intended to insure profitable justice and the elimination of inequality in income and standard of life.
 
• **Secularism** implies equivalency of all persuasions and religious forbearance and doesn't identify any state religion.
 
• The word **integrity** ensures one of the major points and objects of the preamble icing the fraternity and concinnity of the state.
 
• **Article 368** emphasizes that because the preamble is a part of the Indian constitution, it can be amended except for the introductory structure.
